sources.title: PlantGeneAnn: Plant Gene Annotator - GitHub
sources.snippet: PlantGeneAnn is a genome foundation model that enables accurate ab initio gene structure annotation of plant genomes. Built upon the PlantBiMoE architecture with a 1D U-Net-style embeddings decoder head, it automates the prediction of gene structures—including protein-coding genes, CDSs, and exons—on both forward and reverse strands.
